title: Snap Fitness vs Jetts NZ — 24/7 Budget Gym Comparison 2026
meta_desc: Compare Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ prices, locations and equipment for 24/7 budget gym membership
intro: For Kiwis seeking affordable gym memberships with 24/7 access, Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ are two popular options. With over 80 locations across New Zealand, these franchises offer competitive pricing and flexible contract terms. But which one offers better value for money?

sections.heading: Overview of Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ
sections.body: Both Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ operate on a 24/7 model, allowing members to access their facilities at any time. They also offer a range of equipment, including cardio machines, free weights, and strength training equipment. With over 40 locations, Snap Fitness has a strong presence in the North Island, while Jetts NZ has over 40 locations across both islands.

sections.heading: Equipment and Facilities
sections.body: Both Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ offer a range of equipment, including treadmills, elliptical trainers, and stationary bikes. They also have free weights, strength training equipment, and group fitness classes. However, Jetts NZ has a stronger focus on functional training, with equipment such as TRX and battle ropes.

sections.heading: Locations and Accessibility
list: Snap Fitness: over 40 locations in the North Island, including Auckland, Hamilton, and Wellington
Jetts NZ: over 40 locations across both islands, including Christchurch, Queenstown, and Dunedin

sections.heading: Conclusion and Recommendation
sections.body: Ultimately, the choice between Snap Fitness and Jetts NZ depends on your individual needs and preferences. If you prioritize a stronger focus on functional training, Jetts NZ may be the better option. However, if you prefer a wider range of group fitness classes, Snap Fitness may be the way to go. We recommend comparing prices and membership options to find the best value for your money.
